summary.en: A second model rewrites the final reply in the style of your prompt. The rewrite is queued outside the hook, because magpie stops a hook at 10 seconds. Nothing is written back into the session. The history page can show rows only after magpie can read the plugin data directory.
summary.zh: 另一个模型按你的提示词转述最终回复。转述在 hook 外面排队，因为 magpie 把 hook 停在 10 秒。不会写回原会话。翻译记录页要等 magpie 能读插件数据目录，才能显示新记录。
